mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every minimal deficient cut has a graph-legal root-state alternating path ending at a previously unused actual missing B-edge and increasing matching rank by one.
would_close: actual carrier creation for every deficient cut
mechanisms.kill_test: Exact n=14 root reversals and small reserve states: kill universal reachability if a terminal deficient component has no unused actual edge.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Exact full n=14 graph has terminal root-state component, deficiency two, and no free actual carrier; evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The alternating search needs only visit each demand once because no legal root switch can return to a prior carrier with a different ownership state.
mechanisms.kill_test: Find a graph-realizable alternating cycle whose ownership state changes or a repeated state is required; either kills the simple-forest claim.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Independent audit: the witness revisits the same reserve under a different root state, but the claim does not define root state as part of ownership state; literal statement match is not established.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every owned A diagonal in a tight circuit yields a one-demand absorber whose output is an actual B missing edge outside the occupied canonical reserve.
would_close: one new carrier per owned diagonal
mechanisms.kill_test: On the n=14 graph enumerate every missing B-edge and K(bc); kill if all outputs remain bc or cz.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Four owned A diagonals coexist with no missing B-edge outside K(bc); evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A reservoir containing at least twice as many absorber certificates as residual demands always contains disjoint actual absorbers saturating those demands.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build graph-realizable certificates sharing one output or witness; kill if catalogue size grows while absorber matching rank stays one.
mechanisms.status_evidence: No actual bounded-overlap absorber catalogue was present in the exact countergraph, so the conditional absorber-matching route remains unrefuted.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The graph-realizable carrier sets form a matroid on missing B-edges, and each distinct owned A diagonal extends every nonmaximal independent carrier set by basis exchange.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test hereditary and augmentation axioms on small exact reserve systems and the n=14 circuit; kill if three A owners coexist with B rank two and no extending B element.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Independent audit: the intended A-owner to new B-element rank-gain inference is obstructed, but the literal B-ground matroid augmentation claim lacks a typed A-to-B extension map and is not strictly refuted.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The C7 switch digraph is a gammoid whose minimum source-to-free-carrier cut is at least the Hall deficiency in every hard graph.
would_close: disjoint graph-switch paths creating all missing rank
mechanisms.kill_test: On the n=14 graph compute actual sinks outside occupied reserve; kill if positive deficiency coexists with zero free-carrier cut capacity.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The exact graph has positive deficiency and zero path capacity to any free actual B carrier; evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every inclusion-minimal tight reserve circuit admits a simultaneous odd-cycle/root rotation that strictly enlarges its union of actual canonical reserves.
mechanisms.kill_test: Exhaust all root choices on the n=14 three-colour circuit; unchanged base and reserve kill universality.
mechanisms.status_evidence: All 16 graph-legal root states preserve base bc and K(bc); evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Crossing deficient circuits can always be uncrossed to a laminar family while preserving legal reserve neighbourhoods, ownership, and total deficiency, and some leaf rotation releases a new carrier.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use identical-base crossing cuts in the n=14 carrier graph; kill if every union/intersection or rotation preserves deficiency with no released actual edge.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Crossing minimal deficient triples persist under every actual root rotation with no released edge; evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: In every inclusion-minimal hard reserve circuit, two distinct demands share at most half of either demand's actual carrier neighbourhood; iterating this local bound gives a low-codegree nibble matching all but o(D) demands.
mechanisms.kill_test: The n=14 exact graph and blow-ups of identical-base classes: linear codegree equal to degree kills the universal codegree premise.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Pair codegree two equals individual degree two, contradicting the half-degree claim; evidence/GRAPH_REALIZABLE_CARRIER_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After one nibble round, the expected maximum Hall deficiency contracts by a fixed factor whenever total actual carrier count is at least demand count.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate all sampling outcomes on a correlated graph-realizable circuit; kill if every outcome retains the same deficient cut despite sufficient unrelated carriers elsewhere.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The exact countergraph does not meet the actual-carrier-rich antecedent and no universal dummy was substituted; strict kill remains open.
